title: Winter War
summary: The Soviet Union invaded Finland on 30 November 1939 after Finland refused Soviet territorial demands, which were justified by the need to protect Leningrad. Finland resisted for over two months, but a renewed Soviet offensive in February 1940 led to the Moscow Peace Treaty, in which Finland ceded 9% of its territory yet kept its sovereignty.
